primary.factors: positive mean daily RankIC, eight market-candidate tests
primary.model: positive mean daily squared-loss improvement ZERO minus RD, two market tests
primary.correction: Holm FWER0.05. Only current nine-proposal family, older exposed adaptive searches not made independent by correction.

secondary: PearsonIC, spread/median/quintile, incremental partial_rank/residualRankIC (Q0,Q1), RD loss improvement overRidge. Separate Holm6 incremental family (one partial rank per4Quanta-market and two RDvsRidge); exploratory, cannot rescue primary.

uncertainty.method: Circular moving-block bootstrap follows existing V103 resampling pattern; centered null one-sided positive p with +1 finite-simulation correction; percentile95%CI
uncertainty.calendar: reindex market sessions; preserve NaN slots and never relabel across missing dates
uncertainty.not_independent_sample_size: dates/H is only nonoverlap-block upper bound

residual: Per-date cross-section OLS intercept+rankbaseline to remove signal duplication; no outcome used to form score residual, partial Spearman separately residualizes ranked target for evaluation only. No optimized trade weights or new candidate. Q0 baseline=-rank20momentum, Q1 baseline=+rank20momentum; RD baseline=Ridge prediction.

stability.calendar: monthly, calendarhalf, Task12 frozen regime AS_OF vs EX_POST separate
stability.KR_regime: LEGACY_KS11, NO_REGIME_DATA after sourceend, no stitching
stability.attribution: equal date long/short quintile contributions; remove top1/top3 absolute contribution names, top5 absolute contribution dates; posthoc diagnostic not selection
stability.minimum_generalization: No multi-regime confirmation from few overlapping episodes

benchmarks: Frozen index sources per-complete-label interval, source priority Task9_1 then Task10tail, overlap checked. No synthesized index path. Stock return minus same-date index is a common cross-section constant, IC/spread invariant; top/bottom excess separately.
gates: No Task15 automatic. VALIDATED_HISTORICAL requires positive corrected primary, spread consistency and positive robust incremental evidence when claimed, no dominant name/time sensitivity and appropriate data. Exposed S/unknown prior search prevent independent confirmation. Weak/inconsistent=>INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; failed incremental incumbent replication may be REJECTED as incremental research path, not proof no signal.
PBO_DSR_CPCV: N/A unless adequate full trial/return matrix and unseen split history; no fabrication
